createaddonorganizer.configuration.title: Create: Addon Organizer
createaddonorganizer.configuration.absor: Which addon tabs get folded into Create, and where they land.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.force: Tabs to always fold in, even if the mod has no Create dependency.
Tabs to leave alone. They keep their own spot in the tab bar.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.route: Send a tab to a specific Create tab instead of the main one. Format: somemod:deco > create:palettes
createaddonorganizer.configuration.defau: Default Banner Color
createaddonorganizer.configuration.secti: Banner colour per section. Format: somemod:main = #4A4A4A
createaddonorganizer.configuration.banne: Banner image per section. Overrides the colour.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.anima: Marks a banner as animated and sets its frame time in ticks.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.fetch: Check once per launch for new community banners. Ones you already have keep working either way.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.banne: Where the banner list comes from.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.tinte: Draw a tinted box behind section titles so they read on any banner.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.defau: Default Box Color
createaddonorganizer.configuration.boxCo: Box colour per section. Alpha controls opacity.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.boxTe: Box image per section. Overrides the box colour.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.check: Ask Modrinth once per launch whether a newer build exists for your Minecraft version. Nothing downloads -- the notice just opens the mod page.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.fetch: Check once per launch for new community text banners.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.boxMa: Where the text banner list comes from.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.defau: Default Text Color
createaddonorganizer.configuration.twoTo: Shade titles in two colours, primary on top and secondary along the bottom.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.showC: Show Fancy Tab Sections' collapse button on each banner. Off by default, since the banners here aren't drawn for it.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.stick: Keep a section's banner pinned at the top while you scroll its items.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.menuF: Frame cap for menus outside a world. Minecraft locks this to 60, which makes scrolling choppy. Your Max Framerate still applies.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.defau: Default Secondary Text Color
createaddonorganizer.configuration.textS: Bottom colour of two-tone titles, per section.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.title: Default Title Text Shadow
Draw titles with the usual drop shadow.
Per-Section Title Text Shadow
Drop shadow on or off, per section.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.defau: Default Scroll Cutoff
How full a title has to be before it scrolls. 1 only scrolls when it overflows; lower makes short titles scroll too.
Default Text Outline Color
createaddonorganizer.configuration.textO: Outline colour per section. A section only has an outline if it is listed here.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.highl: Row colour for main tabs in the section list. Config screen only, nothing changes in game.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.secti: Saved section order. Anything not listed goes on the end, alphabetically.
Renamed sections. Format: somemod:main = My Name
createaddonorganizer.configuration.index: Look of the section jump list: Vanilla, Dark, Refurbished, Backport, Unique Dark or Adaptive.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.gridB: Draw the 1px lines that close the gaps the item grid leaves above and below a banner. They take their colour from the menu's own texture, so they follow your resource pack.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.edito: Set once you've clicked the banner preview. Turn it off to see the hint again.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.banne: Put the banner preview under the title instead of above the buttons.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.gradi: Pixel size of the colour picker gradients. 1 is smooth, higher looks blockier.
createaddonorganizer.banner.delete.title: Delete this banner?
createaddonorganizer.banner.delete.messa: This permanently removes the uploaded image %s. Any section still using it will fall back to a plain colour next time it's rebuilt.
createaddonorganizer.box.delete.title: Delete this box texture?
createaddonorganizer.box.delete.message: This permanently removes the uploaded image %s. Any section still using it will fall back to a plain colour next time it's rebuilt.
createaddonorganizer.banner.screenshot.s: Banner screenshot saved (path copied to clipboard)
createaddonorganizer.tabs.title: Creative Tab Studio
createaddonorganizer.tabs.full: No spare slots left — restart the game to add more
createaddonorganizer.tabs.emptyTab: Click items on the right to add them.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.name: Tab name
createaddonorganizer.tabs.group.tooltip: Ctrl+click items to pick them out, then fold them into one slot that opens when clicked in the creative menu. Right-click a grouped item to rename it, choose its slot icon, or take the group apart.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.tip.group: Ctrl+click items, then press Group to fold them into one slot.
createaddonorganizer.group.title: Item Group
createaddonorganizer.group.name: Group name
createaddonorganizer.group.icon.tooltip: The item shown on the group's slot while it is closed.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.groups.tooltip: Every item group on this tab, and the import/export that shares them with Condensed Creative.
createaddonorganizer.groups.title: Item Groups
createaddonorganizer.groups.empty: No groups yet -- ctrl+click items in the editor, then press Group
createaddonorganizer.groups.import.toolt: Read Condensed Creative's condensed_entries files out of the loaded resource packs and fold any matching items on this tab into groups. Entries a mod declares in code are not in those files and cannot be read this way.
createaddonorganizer.groups.import.none: No condensed_entries files in the loaded packs
createaddonorganizer.groups.import.noMat: Found %s entries, but none of their items are on this tab
createaddonorganizer.groups.export.toolt: Write this tab's groups as a Condensed Creative entry file under config/createaddonorganizer/condensed_entries, ready to drop into a resource pack.
createaddonorganizer.groups.export.empty: Nothing to export -- this tab has no groups
createaddonorganizer.groups.export.faile: Could not write the export -- see the log
createaddonorganizer.groups.ccNote: Condensed Creative is installed; its own folding is kept off the tabs this mod lays out.
createaddonorganizer.sections.title: %s
createaddonorganizer.tabs.noWorld: No world loaded — a few items with custom renderers show as coloured tiles.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.delete.title: Delete this tab?
createaddonorganizer.tabs.delete.message: "%s" and all of its styling will be removed. This cannot be undone.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.reset.title: Reset this tab?
createaddonorganizer.tabs.reset.message: "%s" goes back to the order and contents its own mod ships. Your sections and removals for it are discarded.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.tip.bulk: Shift + Left click to bulk move items.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.tip.history: CTRL + Z and CTRL + Y to undo / redo.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.tip.banner: Click the pencil on a section to edit its banner.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.resetSection.t: Select a section, then restore just that section to the contents of the tab it was folded in from. Everything else in this tab is left alone.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.resetSection.e: That section's original tab has no items to restore
createaddonorganizer.arranger.title: Tab Arranger
createaddonorganizer.arranger.unsaved.me: You have unsaved tab order changes.
createaddonorganizer.arranger.hintPages: Drag a tab to any slot on any page. Hold near the top or bottom edge to scroll.
createaddonorganizer.arranger.hint: Drag a tab to move it. Drag past the left or right edge to change page.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.arran: Look of the Tab Arranger: Outline, Dark or Vanilla.
Screen edits one page at a time like the real creative menu. Pages shows every page at once.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.tabOr: Saved tab order from the Tab Arranger.
createaddonorganizer.colors.title: Section Banner Colors
createaddonorganizer.colors.hint: Ctrl+Click to rename, Drag to reorder, "Edit" to change colors, Shift + Click to delete.
createaddonorganizer.colors.hint2: Click to select, Double-click or "Edit..." to restyle, Drag to reorder, Ctrl+Click to rename, Shift+Click to delete.
createaddonorganizer.colors.panel.ofTab: Section of %s -- ordered in the tab creator
createaddonorganizer.colors.panel.tabCre: Open the tab this section lives in, in the tab creator. Its items can be reordered there, and its banner is the same one you edit here.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.class: The old organizer menu: one centred column with an Edit button per row, no search or side panel.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.color: Which edge of the section list keeps its tool sidebar. Right sits under the arrow that opens the tab studio. The classic organizer menu has no sidebar, so this does nothing there.
createaddonorganizer.colors.simulatedUne: Create Simulated cannot be edited because it uses a different tab system. This may be changed in the future.
createaddonorganizer.settings.title: All Settings
createaddonorganizer.settings.reset.tool: Put every setting shown on the right back to its default.
createaddonorganizer.settings.reset.mess: Every setting under "%s" goes back to its default. Anything saved by the in-game editors under that heading is lost.
createaddonorganizer.settings.update.too: Version %s is out on Modrinth. Click to open the mod page -- nothing installs itself.
createaddonorganizer.style.title: Menu Style
createaddonorganizer.style.hint: Changes how this mod's screens look. Nothing moves, nothing is removed.
createaddonorganizer.style.default_moder: The settings menu's flat cards, rectangular buttons and gold accent, used on every screen.
createaddonorganizer.style.create.desc: Flat dark panels with light outlines, styled after Create's config editor.
createaddonorganizer.style.essential.des: Flat grey cards with a blue accent, styled after the Essential mod's menus.
createaddonorganizer.style.accent.desc: Change the accent colour used by every button outline, highlight, rule and scrollbar.
createaddonorganizer.style.saturation.de: How vivid the accent colours are. 100% leaves the preset as authored; drag left toward grey or right to intensify.
On: the panorama shows through a dark tint. Off: a flat opaque slate, closer to Create's own config editor.
createaddonorganizer.colors.resetAll.mes: This resets every banner colour/image, box colour, text colour, section order, and tab placement (added/removed sections) back to default. This cannot be undone.
createaddonorganizer.colors.resetPack.to: Hand the sections this pack's script sets up back to the pack. Sections it never mentions keep your edits.
createaddonorganizer.colors.resetPack.me: This drops your own name, colour, banner and placement for every section this pack's script speaks for, so the pack's choices apply again. Sections the pack never mentions are left exactly as you have them.
createaddonorganizer.colors.resetPack.do: Pack sections reset to the pack's defaults
createaddonorganizer.colors.resetPack.no: Nothing to reset -- those sections already use the pack's defaults
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.desc: Presets can save Tab order, Color / images, Names, and tab placement.
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.name: Name this preset
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.appl: This replaces your current banner, box, and text colours/images, section order and names, and tab placement, with the preset's. This cannot be undone.
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.rain: Warning! this preset is commonly associated with lag bugs. although it should be fixed, you never know. BEWARE!!!
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.save: Save Current Config to This Preset
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.dele: This permanently deletes the preset "%s". This cannot be undone.
createaddonorganizer.bugreport.title: Bug Reporting
createaddonorganizer.bugreport.heading: Found a Bug / Issue? Here is how to report it:
createaddonorganizer.bugreport.log: Upload a screenshot (if possible) and your Minecraft log.
createaddonorganizer.bugreport.upload: You should upload it to https://mclo.gs and share the link.
createaddonorganizer.bugreport.account: You also have to have a GitHub account.

createaddonorganizer.colors.credits.cont: Want to Contribute art? Join the
createaddonorganizer.colors.credits.onli: Banners fetch from online, so check this page often! You might see new banners for you to use.
createaddonorganizer.colors.credits.clea: Delete every downloaded banner and fetch them all again. Use this when a banner's art has changed online but you're still seeing the old one.
Cleared %s cached file(s); downloading them again.
Cleared %s cached file(s), but online banners are turned off, so nothing will download.
Local testing is on, so there is nothing downloaded to clear.
createaddonorganizer.colors.textBannerCr: Thank you to everyone who has contributed text banner artwork!
Text banners fetch from online, so check this page often! You might see new text banners for you to use.
createaddonorganizer.colors.highlight.en: Custom highlight color for this tab
createaddonorganizer.colors.unsaved.mess: You have unsaved section order changes.
createaddonorganizer.rename.hint: Leave blank to reset to the default name, or type only spaces for no title at all
createaddonorganizer.addsection.title: Add a Section
createaddonorganizer.colors.tabName.notE: %s has no layout to rename yet
createaddonorganizer.addsection.hub.cycl: Click or scroll to cycle, right-click to go back
createaddonorganizer.bannerAssign.title: Assign Mod Banners
createaddonorganizer.bannerAssign.descri: Dev-only: curate which banners a mod's tab offers, even if it's not installed right now.
createaddonorganizer.bannerAssign.noMatc: No mods or tabs match that search
createaddonorganizer.bannerPool.title: Banner Pool — %s
createaddonorganizer.bannerPool.descript: Click a banner to allow/disallow it. Empty = players see the full unrestricted gallery.
createaddonorganizer.colors.deleteMain.m: This removes "%s" as a main section. Its own tab returns to standalone, and any sections folded into it move back to their default tab. This cannot be undone.
createaddonorganizer.colors.deleteMain.b: This is one of Create's own tabs. Deleting it stops anything from being folded into it -- its own tab returns to plain vanilla, and anything that would otherwise land here (nothing else routes elsewhere) stays standalone instead. Undo later via "Reset All", a preset, or "All Settings".

createaddonorganizer.devmode.unauthorize: I dont know why you are here.
createaddonorganizer.devmode.lockedout: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in %ss.
createaddonorganizer.devmode.spinnerPrev: Loading ring preview - Alt+L to close
createaddonorganizer.configuration.anima: Movement in this mod's screens. Turning one off just makes it happen instantly.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.menuE: The section list sliding and fading in when you open it.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.title: Title Glint
The shine that runs across the section list title.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.smoot: Ease scrolling instead of jumping a notch at a time.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.itemS: Items sliding to their new spot while you drag.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.itemP: The little pop when an item lands in the tab.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.bin.t: The bin's lid, the items falling in and the thump.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.paneR: The split bar easing into place instead of snapping.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.contr: The hints at the top fading between each other. Off leaves one up; clicking still changes it.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.style: The fade when you switch menu styles.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.butto: Buttons easing their outline colour when hovered.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.sound: Sounds this mod's screens make. None of it affects the game.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.allSo: Turn every sound below off at once.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.allAn: Turn every animation below off at once.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.sfxSt: Clicky is sharp and high, Thocky is deeper and duller.
Picking something up to drag it.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.picku: Sweeping extra items into your hand with shift+drag.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.gridS: A dragged item moving one slot.
The split bar snapping to a new column count.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.scrol: A tick per notch when scrolling or dragging a scrollbar.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.block: Undo with nothing left, or scrolling past the end of a list. The scrolling one also needs Scroll Tick on.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.binHo: The lid opening as you drag something over the bin.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.binIt: Each item landing in the bin.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.binCl: The lid shutting once everything has landed.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.appea: Default look of banners, boxes and title text. Anything you change per section lives under Editor Data.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.banne: The coloured bar at the top of each section.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.box.t: The box behind section titles that keeps them readable.
Colour, shading, outline and shadow for section titles.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.creat: How organized tabs behave in the creative menu.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.perfo: Try these first if a menu feels slow.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.onlin: Community banners downloaded from the internet.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.saved: What the editors write down. You can edit these by hand, but the editors are easier.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.extra: Tabs that other tabs are allowed to fold into. Add one with shift + "+" in the creative menu.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.rainb: Colour every banner by its position, red through violet, instead of using the colour lists.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.defau: Banner colour for sections you haven't coloured yourself.
Default Banner Gradient
Second colour for the default banner: hex|DIRECTION|STYLE. Empty means flat.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.showA: Show the whole banner gallery instead of the picks for each tab.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.defau: Box colour for sections you haven't set one on. Alpha controls how solid it is.
Default Box Darkening
Darkens box images. 0 leaves them alone, 1 is black.
Default Box Opacity
How solid box images are drawn. 0 is invisible, 1 is solid.
Title colour for sections you haven't coloured yourself.
Default Text Gradient
Second colour for the default title: hex|DIRECTION. Empty means flat.
The bottom colour of two-tone titles.
Default Secondary Text Gradient
Second colour for the secondary title colour: hex|DIRECTION. Empty means flat.
Default Two-Tone Split
Where two-tone titles switch colour, measured down the letter. 0 is all bottom colour, 1 is all top.
Default Shadow Colour
Shadow colour for sections whose shadow you unlinked from the title colour.
Colour the Outline panel starts on. Sections have no outline until you give them one.
Default Outline Gradient
Second colour for the default outline: hex|DIRECTION. Empty means flat.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.menuS: Look of this mod's screens. Default is vanilla widgets, Default (Modern) puts the settings menu's flat cards and gold accent everywhere, Create copies Create's config editor, Essential uses grey cards.
Create style only. Lets the panorama show through instead of a flat slate background.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.menuA: Create style only. Hue for outlines, text and scrollbars. 205 is Create's blue, 280 purple, 120 green, -1 grey.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.cache: Cache item icons instead of rebuilding their models every frame. Much faster with big grids. Turn off if an icon looks wrong.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.banne: Where each tab's banner picks come from. Editing that file updates them without a mod update.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.extra: Your own uploads added to a tab's banner picks.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.textS: Shadow colour per section, for shadows unlinked from the title colour.
createaddonorganizer.colors.native.relea: "%s" handed back to the mod that draws it
createaddonorganizer.configuration.textB: Tinted title box on or off, per section. A section without an entry follows the global toggle.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.nativ: Sections whose banner, colours and title were copied in from the mod that drew them. Remove an ID to copy its original look in again.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.slide: The slide between menus: one leaves the way you are heading, the next arrives from behind it.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.scree: Slide between menus instead of cutting straight to the next one.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.swoos: How long the menu you are leaving takes to slide away, in milliseconds.
The pause on an empty background between the two menus. Zero makes the swap land on the same frame as the fade, which reads as a flicker.
How long the arriving menu takes to settle, in milliseconds.
How far a menu slides, in GUI pixels, so it scales with your GUI scale.
Fade the menu out as it leaves. Off slides it without fading.
How the leaving menu picks up speed. ACCELERATE gathers pace, SMOOTH eases both ends, LINEAR is mechanical, WINDUP recoils first.
How the arriving menu settles. DECELERATE matches the menu’s own entrance, OVERSHOOT and SPRING carry it past its resting place and back.
The left arrow, to all settings.
The right arrow, to the Creative Tab Studio.
Opening a section’s banner and colour editor.
The presets browser and its edit screens.
The banner credits and bug report screens.
Tab Studio’s own screens: the arranger, the tab editor and the tab picker.
Leaving a screen, which plays the same motion in reverse.
createaddonorganizer.slide.title: Menu Slide
createaddonorganizer.slide.hint: Drag a slider, then press Play to watch it.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.swoos: The organizer menu sliding in when you open it. Leaving never slides -- it closes on the frame you press Done.
Which way screens reached without the arrows travel. UP sends the old screen upward and brings the new one from below, DOWN is the reverse, SIDEWAYS makes them page like the arrows do.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.itemG: Draw a small +/- marker on an item group's slot, so a closed group reads as one you can open rather than an ordinary item.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.banne: Log one line per section the first time its banner is drawn: the texture bound, its frame count and the colours in play. For chasing a banner that will not show.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.alway: Banners that keep animating while not hovered. Format: textureId = true. Banners absent from this list only animate on hover.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.openI: Item groups currently opened out in the creative menu. Managed by clicking a group's slot.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.nativ: How the copies above were made. Raised when a fix changes what a faithful copy looks like. Lower it by hand to force every copied-in section to be made again.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.menuA: Create style only. Saturation of every accent as a percentage of the palette's own colours. 100 leaves them as authored, 0 is greyscale, 200 doubles the intensity.
Essential style only. Saturation of every accent as a percentage of the palette's own colours. Defaults higher than the Create style because Essential's palette is built around a far more vivid blue.
Default (Modern) style only. How vivid the gold accent is, as a percentage of the palette's own colours. 100 leaves it as authored.
